name: Lemon house style
notes: Used by every Lemon procedure guide in this repo. Guide-page rules are under guidePage.
Warm near-black background, muted teal accent, amber and brick-red for status.
Numbers always use the mono face with tabular figures so columns line up.
Inputs are 16px so iOS Safari doesn't zoom on focus.
Mobile first: 720px max content width, fixed bottom tab bar, safe-area insets.

bg.use: page background, sticky topbar, PWA theme/background color

card.use: card and tab bar surface, default button fill

muted.use: labels, secondary text, inactive tabs, table heads

accent.use: primary buttons, active tab, focus ring, links, eyebrow text, progress fill when on track

accent-soft.use: tinted info panels, note callouts, torque/spec chips, selected row

accent-ink.use: headings, big numbers, the app title, toast background, text on accent-soft

good.use: positive status text, checked-off step border and number (same as accent)

warn.use: caution status text, caution callout border and tag

bad.use: negative status text, danger buttons, behind-pace progress fill, error toast, hard-limit callout border and tag

bad-bg.use: negative chip background, danger button border

idle-bg.use: neutral/no-target chip background, inline code, unhighlighted sequence cells

thrive.meaning: at or above the stretch target

display.use: h1, h2, h3, eyebrow labels, tab bar, period navigator label

mono.use: every number: money, stats, big figures, chips, number/date/time inputs

layout.topbar: sticky, bg background, 3px accent bottom border, padding calc(12px + safe-area-top) 16px 10px
layout.tabbar: fixed bottom, card background, 1px line top border, equal-width buttons, active = accent text + 3px inset top bar
layout.bodyBottomPadding: calc(66px + safe-area-bottom) to clear the tab bar

components.card: background card, 1px solid line, radius 10px, padding 14px, margin-bottom 12px
components.cardLive: card with 5px solid accent left border (line color when idle)
components.button: inherit font, radius 8px, 1px solid line, background card, text color, padding 12px 14px
components.buttonPrimary: background + border accent, text on-accent, weight 700
components.input: 16px, background field, 1px solid line, radius 8px, padding 10px, full width; focus = 2px solid accent outline, offset -1px
components.label: column flex, gap 4px, 13px muted, margin-bottom 10px
components.chip: inline-block pill, padding 3px 9px, 12px weight 600 mono, colors from status map
components.progressBar: 10px tall, radius 5px, track color; fill = bad when behind, accent when on track; optional 2px text-colored tick marking expected-by-today
components.dataRows: CSS grid rows, 14px, 9px vertical padding, 1px line separators; header row 11px uppercase muted; today's row bold accent-ink; numbers right-aligned
components.infoPanel: 13px, padding 8px 10px, radius 8px, accent-soft background with accent-ink text (warn variant uses warn-bg/warn)
components.toast: fixed bottom-center above tab bar, accent-ink background, bg-colored text, 14px weight 600, radius 8px, fades via opacity .2s; error variant bad background
components.selectedRow: accent-soft background, radius 6px, bleeds 8px past the row edges

colorRules.noNewColors: Guides use only the tokens above. The earlier guide's separate blue note color and olive accent are dropped; notes use accent-soft/accent, cautions use warn, hard limits use bad.
colorRules.textOnTint: Body text on any *-bg or accent-soft stays text; tags on accent-soft use accent-ink, not accent (8.5:1 vs 4.9:1).
colorRules.contrast: Checked pairs, WCAG ratio: text/warn-bg 10.7, warn/warn-bg 6.1, accent-ink/accent-soft 8.5, accent/accent-soft 4.9, bad/bad-bg 4.8, muted/card 7.5, accent/bg 7.1. All pass AA for normal text.
colorRules.doneState: A checked step keeps its colors and drops to opacity .62; do not grey it to muted, or the torque chips inside lose contrast.

guidePage.topbar: sticky, bg, 3px accent bottom border; eyebrow (year, model, engine) then h1 accent-ink; 10px progress bar (track, accent fill) with mono done/total count
guidePage.jumpNav: horizontal scroll row under the topbar; chips are card fill, 1px line, radius 8px, 15px Barlow Condensed uppercase, muted text; hover/focus accent
guidePage.sectionHeading: h2 26px accent-ink, then a 40x3px accent rule, then a muted 15px sub line
guidePage.step: card fill, 1px line, 5px line-colored left border, radius 10px, padding 12px 14px; numbered pill in mono, numbering restarts per list; tap toggles done (good left border, good-bg number pill, opacity .62); state saved to localStorage only
guidePage.torqueChip: inline mono 600, accent-ink on accent-soft, radius 6px, never wraps; every number the reader sets a tool to

callouts.warn: warn-bg fill, 4px warn left border, warn tag; manual cautions and 'check your engine' notices
callouts.note: accent-soft fill, 4px accent left border, accent-ink tag; context and side notes
callouts.bad: bad-bg fill, 4px bad left border, bad tag; manual warnings and scrap/replace limits

guidePage.specTable: card fill inside a 1px line, radius 10px; Barlow Condensed uppercase muted head; first column Barlow, spec column mono tabular; qualifiers in 12px muted on their own line
guidePage.figure: manual scan on a white (#FFFFFF, --plate) block, radius 8px, padding 8px, image max-width 100% at natural size with width/height set and lazy loading; 12px muted caption under it naming the manual figure; sits inside the step it illustrates; the image links to the full-size file and tapping it does not toggle the step
guidePage.sequenceDiagram: bolt order drawn as a 5-column grid of mono pills on idle-bg, first bolt on accent-soft/accent-ink, dashed line outline; orientation matches the manual figure
guidePage.footer: 13px muted, 1px line top border; names the LEMON manual year, model, engine and every section used
guidePage.images: Include the manual's figures wherever a step, sequence or spec table has one (bolt orders, timing marks, exploded views, scanned torque tables). Fetch with the Lemon MCP get_image tool, save with tools/save-figures.py under guides/img/<guide-name>/, reference with a relative path, give each a caption naming the manual figure, 100% max width on a white card so the black-on-white scans stay readable in the dark theme.
